traits.juvenile_period_years.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual (Betula, table 3, read): minimum seed-bearing age 15 years. FEIS (Uchytil 1991, read): seed production begins at about age 15. It sets adult_age through the rule at the seed plants (spec rework P6), in place of the 10 years set by hand.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a slender tree with a narrow, open crown, alternate oval, toothed leaves and hanging catkins. Not fitted to measurements. Its pipe_tip, pipe_organ and pipe_rings are scaled together (crown calibration, broadleaf revision 9) so that, with the leaf its crown now keeps, its trunk reaches the reference dbh of 25 cm at 40 years again.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 16 m tall and 25 cm across at breast height at 40 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green leaves; white bark peeling in papery strips. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: slender hanging fruiting catkins 3 to 5 cm long, green going brown. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: catkins in April and May; the fruiting catkins green in summer, brown in August and September, breaking up in the autumn. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): white bark peeling in papery strips round the stem from orange-brown inner bark, with dark horizontal lenticels; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Leaf families (plant roadmap P4, `families`): sun leaves somewhat smaller and narrower than shade leaves; set from general knowledge of sun and shade leaves and juvenile foliage, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
